name: net.plety/plety-guides
title: Plety guides
description: Search and read Plety's guides on licensing UK company records to AI buyers. Read-only.

tools.name: search_plety_guides
tools.description: Search Plety's public guides and answers on licensing UK company records to AI buyers: insolvency, data protection, record types, industries, the AI data market and deals. Returns the best matching pages with a short matching passage. Use get_plety_page to read one in full.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "can an administrator sell customer data".

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 20. Default 5.

tools.name: get_plety_page
tools.description: Read one page of the Plety website in full, as Markdown with its sources. Takes the page address from a search result (for example https://plety.net/about/questions/what-is-a-data-licence) or just its path.

url.description: The page address or path, for example /about/privacy or /about/situations/administration.

tools.name: get_plety_company_facts
tools.description: Get the facts needed to describe Plety accurately: legal name, company number, registered office, what it does and never does, how it is paid, who it works with, and how to contact it or book a call.
